name: Warm Leadshot
description: Slip the cord's loop over the middle finger and pinch the tail between thumb and forefinger before each whirl.

name: Square Wristhitch
description: Swing the loaded pouch in a slow upright circle above the head to gather speed before letting go.

name: Cradlebump
description: Open the thumb and forefinger at the top of the circle so the stone leaves flat toward the mark.

name: Slingdash
description: From beside the hip the pouch swings back then up and the stone is loosed in a short arc at a near target.

name: Fixing Slung
description: Crack the empty pouch beside a beast's head so the sharp snap startles it back a pace.

name: Peltpace
description: After the release slide the rear foot back half a pace to clear space and make ready to reload.

name: Warm Slingstone
description: Plant the feet a shoulder apart with the off foot forward so the whirl never drags the body off balance.

name: Gnawing Orbit
description: Whirl the pouch in a level circle at waist height to throw low and straight across open ground.

name: Warm Cordleft
description: Count each turn of the whirl aloud until the hand knows which beat is the one that opens.

name: Pouch Count
description: Weigh several stones in the palm and keep the round even one that will fly true.

name: Tending Slingtether
description: Seat the stone deep in the pouch's cup so it rides steady through every turn of the circle.

name: Stiff Cordright
description: Whip the stone out after only half a turn in a quick flick that hits a close target hard.

name: Tight Fingerhitch
description: Lift the stretched cord and forearm together to turn aside a thrown pebble or a snapping muzzle.

name: Measured Cradle
description: Bind the retention loop snugly about the wrist so a hard release never loses the cord.

name: Mild Releasecord
description: Hold the gaze on one spot of the target through the whole whirl until the stone is gone.

name: Stonepelt Hit
description: Roll the shoulder over and fling from above the ear so the stone drops onto the mark at a steep line.

name: Short Singing
description: Hurl a hard clod of earth at a crowd's front rank so the spray makes them flinch and slow.

name: Kind Slingstone
description: Draw the next stone from the belt pouch with the free hand while the cord hangs from the other.

name: Cradlecount
description: Pull the cord out to full arm span and mark the length that suits the thrower's own reach.

name: Orbitbump
description: Drive the whirl from the turning hip and not the arm so the release carries the whole body's strength.

name: Smooth Pouch
description: Spin the unloaded sling on a steady beat to build wrist rhythm without wasting a single stone.

name: Upward Slingtether
description: Let go a breath early for a flat flight or a breath late for a high lob.

name: Straight Orbit
description: Whirl the pouch behind the shoulder and let go forward so the arm never shows beyond cover.

name: Slingnote
description: Rest the forearm on a rail or branch top and judge the range by the target's width against a finger.

name: Slingdrop
description: Seat two small pebbles in the pouch and release together so they spread and cover a wider mark.

name: Swaying Flingaway
description: Roll away to the left after releasing and rise already reloading so the old spot lies empty.

name: Slingreview
description: Lift and slowly whirl a heavy stone to strengthen the shoulder and forearm for longer throws.

name: Sudden Slung
description: Whirl three full turns and release at the top of the circle to carry the stone to the farthest mark.

name: Raised Cordleft
description: Wrap the cord around the knuckles as a rough guard and turn a glancing blow off the hand.

name: Pelthusk
description: Whip the loose cord across a charging dog's muzzle to turn it aside before the stone is set.

name: Slingbump
description: Snap a small flint chip at an enemy's wrist so the grip loosens on whatever it holds.

name: Even Wristhitch
description: Test the cord's stretch and dampness by feel before each throw so the release stays reliable.

name: Releasecord Note
description: Run a thread of qi along the cord so it keeps its tension and the stone leaves cleanly.

name: Cradlereview
description: Read the distance to the mark by its size against the thumb and set the whirl to match.

name: Single Leadshot
description: Push a small pulse of qi into the stone at release so it flies flatter and farther.

name: Downward Fingerhitch
description: Hold the breath at the top of the whirl and loose the stone on the exhale for a motionless line.

name: Pouchbump
description: Throw two pebbles together at a mark so one is likely to find it even if the first strays.

name: Folded Wristhitch
description: Tuck the elbow and turn the shoulder to cover the face while reloading under thrown stones.

name: Pouchskitter
description: Slide back one step as the stone leaves to keep the same distance from a closing enemy.

name: Mild Cordright
description: Draw the first thin flow of qi down the arm and into the cord so the whirl runs hot and taut.

name: Calm Slingstone
description: Press a lead bullet into the pouch seat with a breath of qi so it cannot roll.

name: Orbithit
description: Feed qi in pulses through each turn so the pouch circles faster than the arm alone can drive it.

name: Level Stonepelt
description: Snap the cord's tip with a spark of qi so the loose end cracks against a close foe's skin.

name: Ready Leadshot
description: Wind the cord over the forearm and stiffen it with qi to turn a cut or a bite aside.

name: Even Cordleft
description: Run qi along the braid to set its strands even so the cord pulls straight at the release.

name: Even Pouch
description: Feel the knotted tail slide across the fingertips and know the exact moment it will free.

name: Cradledrop
description: Open the fingers in one smooth motion so the stone leaves without a wobble or a drag.

name: Level Cradle
description: Throw at half the whirl when the cord is worn so it does not part in mid-turn.

name: Singing Skitter
description: Let the swing of the empty pouch pull the body one light step sideways out of a rush.

name: Pouchlid
description: Flick the loose cord around a reaching hand and hold it for a heartbeat while stepping clear.

name: Steady Cradle
description: Run a thumb over the bullet in the pouch to feel that its seam lies along the throw.

name: Slungdrop
description: Loose clay pellets one after another on a steady beat so each leaves before the last has landed.

name: Descending Pelt
description: Lob a small acorn-shaped bullet in a high short arc to drop it behind a low wall or hedge.

name: Cradleblow
description: Fling a handful of gravel from a half whirl into a crowd's front so the rank hesitates.

name: Narrow Slingtether
description: Send the bullet in low so it skips off hard ground and rises into a mark behind cover.

name: Angled Fingerhitch
description: Hold the stiffened pouch against the chest to turn aside small thrown stones.

name: Pouchnote
description: Flush the releasing hand with qi for one beat so the fingers open without a flinch.

name: Pelt Hop
description: Let a spent bullet fall and take a quick step back to draw the next from the belt.

name: Releasecord Review
description: Hold the cord up and watch how it drifts to judge the crosswind before choosing the aim.

name: Slungblow
description: Whirl wide and long over flat ground then loose the stone on a rising line to the far mark.

name: Hard Pelt
description: Shorten the whirl when throwing down a slope so the stone does not overshoot its target.

name: Gnawing Cordright
description: Throw pebbles in quick succession along a narrow lane to keep an advancing line pinned and slow.

name: Low Orbit
description: Loose the stone steeply upward so it falls out of the sky onto a target behind a screen.

name: Even Cordright
description: Draw a matched stone from the belt pocket in one motion without looking down from the mark.

name: Skipping Slingstone
description: Sidestep out of the line of an incoming stone and load the next in the same movement.
